title: Count Odd and Even Elements in Array

content.problemStatement:
Complete the code snippet below to print the count of the number of odd and even elements
in an unsorted array.

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the expected output following problem rules.
Input produces the expected output following problem rules.

solution.approach: Count the number of odd and even elements in the array.

code.Python3:
import sys
def main():
    toks = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not toks: return
    n = int(toks[0])
    arr = [int(x) for x in toks[1:n+1]]
    odd = sum(1 for x in arr if x % 2 != 0)
    even = sum(1 for x in arr if x % 2 == 0)
    print(f"{odd} {even}")
if __name__ == "__main__": main()

solution.editorial: Iterate through elements, incrementing odd count if element % 2 != 0 and even count otherwise.
